import pytest

# Test case 1: None should return default
def test_none_returns_default():
    assert effective_limit(None, default=5) == 5

# Test case 2: Zero should return zero

    assert effective_limit(0) == 0
    assert effective_limit(0, default=10) == 0

# Test case 3: Positive int should override default
def test_positive_int_overrides_default():
    assert effective_limit(15, default=10) == 15
    assert effective_limit(1) == 1

        effective_limit(-5)

        effective_limit(-10, default=5)
